definitions.gloss: collection point; collection site; gathering place
definitions.explanation: A designated location where things are gathered or collected, most commonly used for garbage and recycling collection points in residential areas.

examples.japanese: ⟦ごみ→ゴミ：00840_gomi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{集積所|しゅうせきじょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|だ}して→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please put your garbage at the collection point.

examples.japanese: ⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧{八時|はちじ}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{集積所|しゅうせきじょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ごみ→ゴミ：00840_gomi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦{決|き}まり→決まり：02548_kimari⟧だ。
examples.english: The rule is to put garbage at the collection point by 8 a.m.

examples.japanese: ⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}して→引っ越す：01171_hikkosu⟧きた⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦ごみ→ゴミ：00840_gomi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{集積所|しゅうせきじょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦どこか→どこか：02361_dokoka⟧⟦{分|わ}からなかった→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: Since I had just moved in, I didn't know where the garbage collection point was.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {集積|しゅうせき} (accumulation, collection) + {所|じょ} (place). Most commonly used in daily life to refer to the designated garbage collection spot in a neighborhood. In Japan, garbage must be taken to a specific community collection point, not left at the curb in front of one's own house.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦ごみ→ゴミ：00840_gomi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{集積所|しゅうせきじょ} (garbage collection point)
- {集積所|しゅうせきじょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ (to put out at the collection point)
- {集積所|しゅうせきじょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{掃除|そうじ}→掃除：02889_souji⟧ (cleaning the collection point)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ごみ→ゴミ：00840_gomi⟧⟦{置|お}き{場|ば}→置き場：22477_okiba⟧: garbage spot — a more casual/colloquial term
- {集積場|しゅうせきば}: collection site — similar meaning, sometimes used for larger-scale operations
